Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.input

Class PlayerOrders

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.input.PlayerOrders
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerInput
public final class PlayerOrders extends Object implements PlayerInput
What the user asks the player to do right now (Q38): a direction to walk in and a point to attack towards. The desktop writes it every frame from the keyboard and the mouse; the player reads it every logic tick, so an order is never lost when a frame runs no tick.
